# Yichuan Wang / Charlie-Wang-03

> Public technical profile of Yichuan Wang (GitHub: Charlie-Wang-03), an Applied Mathematics M.S. student at Fudan University whose public work spans Scientific Machine Learning, AI for Science & Mathematics, AI agents and agent reliability, reproducible research workflows, scientific computing, and open-source engineering.

Use the canonical profile files for identity and current positioning. Use each linked project's own README or upstream pull request for project-specific technical claims. Private repositories and non-public information are outside the scope of this public profile.

## Core profile

- [English public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/README.md): Canonical English profile and current public positioning.
- [Simplified Chinese public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/README.zh-CN.md): Natural Simplified Chinese companion with the same public facts.
- [Structured public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/PROFILE.md): Compact identity, technical areas, selected work, public activity, academic identifiers, and source boundaries.
- [Schema.org Person metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/profile.jsonld): Machine-readable public identity and selected-work metadata.

## Selected public work

- [AI4Math Chronicle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-chronicle/main/README.md) — Bilingual timeline of mathematical AI milestones with primary sources and verification status.
- [Creative-Intelligence (upstream contribution)](https://github.com/DeepMathLLM/Creative-Intelligence/pull/7) — Merged checks for duplicate objects and missing result archives when resuming mathematical discovery runs.
- [AI4Math Radar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-radar/main/README.md) — AIHOT-derived feed that groups recent reports by event and links to the underlying sources.
- [Sightline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/dsh-sightline/main/README.md) — Compares observed DeepSeek Harness instructions with predictions for Codex and Claude Code.
- [Zotero Mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/zotero-mirror/main/README.md) — Template for syncing Zotero metadata, notes and annotations into a versioned private GitHub repository.
- [SLURM Dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/slurm-dashboard/main/README.md) — Self-hosted cluster dashboard that shows the shell commands behind its queue and GPU views.

## Open-source contributions

- [OpenHands / software-agent-sdk #5029](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/pull/5029) (merged) — Normalized LLM usage telemetry through a typed adapter.
- [Harbor #3491](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/3491) (merged) — Distinguished verifier environment startup timeouts from timeouts during verification.
- [AIHOT #161](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/AIHOT/pull/161) (merged) — Committed event grouping and its completion receipt in the same database transaction.
- [DeepMathLLM / Moonshine #4](https://github.com/DeepMathLLM/Moonshine/pull/4) (open) — Proposed a tool execution journal for recovery after an interrupted turn.
